svg.title: From block 32 through the sampler and VAE decoder to RGB
svg.desc: The output head keeps the target rows and predicts a 128-dimensional flow velocity per token. The Euler sampler updates those same target latents. On subsequent denoising passes it uses the new timestep and latents, the original prompt embeddings and the layer-specific reference KV cache. After the final pass the latents are scattered to their grid, inverse-normalized, unpatchified and decoded into RGB. The separately shown apple photo pair documents a VAE reconstruction of the reference photograph.
